import json
from collections import Counter

output_df = input_df_1.copy()
output_mask = pd.DataFrame(True, index=output_df.index, columns=output_df.columns)

probe = {}
for col in ['quantity', 'order_date']:
    series = input_df_1[col]
    dtype_str = str(series.dtype)
    samples = []
    for i in range(min(3, len(series))):
        val = series.iloc[i]
        tname = pd.api.types.infer_dtype(pd.Series([val]), skipna=False)
        samples.append({'type': tname, 'repr': str(val)[:30]})
    type_counts = dict(Counter(
        pd.api.types.infer_dtype(pd.Series([v]), skipna=False)
        for v in series
    ))
    probe[col] = {'dtype': dtype_str, 'samples': samples, 'type_counts': type_counts}

msg = 'INPUT_TYPE_PROBE' + json.dumps(probe, separators=(',', ':'))
